lines.text: For 27 years, American sunscreens used the same old filters. That just changed.
lines.say: For twenty-seven years, American sunscreens used the same old filters. That just changed.

lines.text: The old UVA filter, avobenzone, breaks down in sunlight, so it needs extra stabilisers.
lines.say: The old UVA filter, avobenzone, breaks down in sunlight, so it needs extra stabilisers.

lines.text: The new one, bemotrizinol, covers UVA and UVB, stays stable in the sun, and very little passes through your skin.
